sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The ⏳ pending-edits filter no longer erases the thing it filtered on. Pressing it — or checking "⏳ has pending edits" / a "» pending edit:" entry in the 📊 dropdown — used to paint each matching entity with the ordinary column-filter background, which covered MusicBrainz's own orange "modification pending" marker completely. The rows were right and the one signal you had pressed the button to find was gone.

Those matches are now RINGED instead: the text is left exactly as it reads unfiltered and a bold outline is drawn around the whole marker, orange and all. Same idea as the red ring a matching relationship icon already gets, and for the same reason — the target carries a visual of its own that a background would destroy.
The ring encloses the entity-kind icon too, where MusicBrainz's marker wraps one. On a joined credit only the half with open edits is ringed, exactly as before.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New "Pending-Edits Match Outline Color" setting, next to the other filter-highlight colours, picks that ring's colour. Dark red by default: MusicBrainz's own pending-edit marker is a pale yellow, so a yellow ring drawn on it is very nearly invisible — which is exactly what the first attempt at this looked like.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: ❓ Help's ⏳ PENDING-EDITS FILTER TOGGLE section and the 📊 dropdown's "Pending edits" entry now describe the ring, and say why the pending-edits filters are the only ones that get one: for every other filter the highlight COLOUR is what tells you which filter matched, so typing a query that happens to match inside a pending entity still highlights it the usual way.
